Scenarios.Title: ESXi NTP service stopped
Scenarios.Impact: One host loses time synchronization; drift develops over time, not immediately.

Scenarios.Title: ESXi DNS points to an invalid resolver
Scenarios.Impact: Hostname resolution and DNS-related readiness checks fail on one host.

Scenarios.Title: vMotion disabled on its VMkernel interface
Scenarios.Impact: Migrations involving this host and upgrade evacuation can fail.

Scenarios.Title: DRS changed to manual
Scenarios.Impact: Automatic placement and evacuation require intervention.

Scenarios.Title: Disposable VM NIC disconnected
Scenarios.Impact: user-vm-a loses connectivity immediately and after power cycling.

Scenarios.Title: Disposable VM attached to the wrong portgroup
Scenarios.Impact: The NIC stays connected but the static guest address is on the wrong VLAN.

Scenarios.Title: Restrictive 100 MHz VM CPU limit
Scenarios.Impact: Guest becomes sluggish despite apparent host CPU headroom.

Scenarios.Title: Snapshot left for pre-upgrade hygiene review
Scenarios.Impact: A new disk-only snapshot appears. This is a hygiene exercise, not a universal hardware-upgrade blocker.

Scenarios.Title: BGP uplink VLAN missing from Edge trunk
Scenarios.Impact: VLAN 49 is removed from uplink 1; TEP VLAN 48 and uplink 2 remain. Expect two external BGP sessions down.

Scenarios.Title: Workload Tier-0 BGP disabled
Scenarios.Impact: HIGH IMPACT: all four external BGP sessions drop. Workload north-south and Supervisor load-balancer access fail. Recover through the management NSX endpoint.

Scenarios.Title: VCF 5.2.1 management NSX admin password forced to expire
Scenarios.Impact: VCF 5.2.1 NSX admin UI/API access and SDDC Manager operations using that credential can fail. Recovery uses root through vc-mgmt-b Guest Operations.

Scenarios.Title: vCenter Machine SSL certificate signed by an untrusted lab CA
Scenarios.Impact: HIGH IMPACT: normal clients reject the vCenter certificate. Existing HTTPS integrations can lose connectivity. Recovery restores the original certificate/key.
